correctness.rationale: For each of the seven exhaustive triples of path lengths \(2\le a\le b\le c\) and \(a+b+c\le9\), the \(R=\mathbb Z[t]/(t^3-1)\) dynamic program produces each ternary Fourier coefficient as a three-entry integer residue vector. Evaluation at a primitive third root vanishes exactly if all three entries coincide. A completely separate direct proper-colouring enumeration agrees with all 25029 residue vectors, confirming the precise 584 zeros for \((2,3,4)\), its degree census (4,8,74,106,210,138,44) in degrees 2 through 8, and nonzero balanced coefficients otherwise. Fourier diagonalization gives convolution rank 1603. The four degree-two zeros are exactly two colour-independent vertex pairs, each with 54 equality assignments among 162 colourings. The standalone replay_check.py and its inputs were executed successfully.

value.rationale: The family is the canonical 2-connected three-branch generalization beyond single cycles and terminal-edge gluings. The seven cases are the entire natural up-to-eight-vertices range; their first sharp Fourier-rank obstruction is unique and substantially nontrivial, with 584 extra cancellations and the concrete statistical surprise of two exactly independent nonadjacent vertex-colour pairs. These facts give a precise recoverability boundary and benchmark for spectral weighted-colouring methods; the result claims neither an all-order theta classification nor an unproved application.
